GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down Two Wide trailing a half length, Drifted Back to 4.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, moved back up to 3rd place in Straight but distanced by the winner # battled on fairly
Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down 5th 1x1 with cover 2 1/2 Lengths Under Pressure x 600m, Couldn'T Go On Turning for home - # Prefer To See Again

Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, little change to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Up home turn & shifted 3 Wide rounding turn, blocked on straightening, switched inside eventual winner at the top of the straight, switched back outside winner at the 75m, Made Some Ground to the line. [Stewards: raced keenly early stages.] # no luck in Straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start. Raced keen early. Held up approaching and round home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off 3 wide, under pressure turn and dropped out # mostly Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover from near the 1400m to the 1000m. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding, which weakened in the home straight, did not reveal any abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence (slow pace), Drifted Back to 6 Lengths rail turning, improved only a length or So in Straight # never a real threat
Jumped Ok sat rail 5l off, saved ground turn, took over Straightening Up , drew 2-3l clear 200m and kept on strong to the line # All honours
Jumped Ok eased to last 9l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier, was shifted behind runners in the early stages. Passing the 200m had to be checked.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair Eased back early Settled Down 6l Worse than midfield comes Wide across top home turn 4l very Wide Straightening Up picks up ground the died on run last 100 Fitter and ok for longer # fitter/stayer/ok
Bit Slow Out 1 length settled last 10l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 200m shifted in to avoid the heels of another runner which laid out. Was held up and unable to obtain completely clear running from the 150m when racing tight between teo other runners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 5-6l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on ok but no threat # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was passed suitable to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: 2 Lengths Slow away. Not pushed early & raced well back Two Wide (7L from lead). Back 2 Lengths midrace & improving 3 Wide from 700m & Four Wide @ 550m. Pushed along Seven Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 300m & ground home @ one pace in straight. # One-paced.
